title: senderDisplayName fallback references undefined 'login' field
description: §5.2 defines the fallback chain for senderDisplayName as: displayName → login → senderId. The field 'login' is not defined in this spec nor clearly tied to a field in ChatContact in JMAP-CHAT. If ChatContact has no 'login' field, this is a dangling reference. Needs either a normative definition or a pointer to where it is defined.
close_reason: Not a bug: ChatContact.login IS defined in JMAP-CHAT §ChatContact (line 315). The reference is correct.
